name: raycast-import
title: Raycast Import
description: Import data exported from Raycast (snippets, clipboard history, emoji) into Vicinae.
author: danielfstefan

commands.name: import-data
commands.title: Import Raycast Data
commands.description: Import snippets, clipboard history, and emoji history from a Raycast export (.json or encrypted .rayconfig)

commands.name: import-clipboard
commands.title: Import Clipboard History (background)
commands.description: Headless helper: replays the decrypted clipboard history through Vicinae's own recorder. Launched automatically by 'Import Raycast Data' — no need to run this directly.
